sources.snippet: PPO Agent for LunarLander-v3 A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent trained with Stable-Baselines3 for Unit 1 of the Hugging Face Deep Reinforcement Learning Course. The agent learns to land safely by choosing among four discrete actions using an eight-value observation vector.
